intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lake Forest for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Candlelight Walk at Heritage Hill Historical Park) through December 16 (North Pole Calling), with Holiday Lights at Heritage Hill Historical Park (December 11 to December 13) and Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lake Forest

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Lake Forest
  • 3 free events: Candlelight Walk at Heritage Hill Historical Park, Holiday Lights at Heritage Hill Historical Park and Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony
  • Meet Santa: the Candlelight Walk at Heritage Hill has a visit with Santa Claus, and North Pole Calling gives Lake Forest children ages 3 to 8 a phone call from Santa (December 16)
  • Tree lightings: Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Civic Center Campus (December 12)
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest is the Santa's Village at Irvine Park Railroad in Orange, which lists train rides
  • Season: December 4 to December 16

Planning a bigger day out? Lake Forest families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Knott's Merry Farm, the Anaheim Tree Lighting Ceremony and Anaheim Ballet's Nutcracker.
